result.reason: The revision does not reach even the fallback: it does not extend the licence to affiliates on notice or permit transfer to an M&A successor. It also does not cover contractors, provide successor transferability generally, distinguish paid-up licences as perpetual and irrevocable, or limit termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach. Instead, irrevocability is qualified by any termination permitted under Section 4, whose grounds are not constrained here. The edit is narrow and preserves the remaining commercial language, but the phrase “irrevocable during the Term except upon termination” is awkward, and the blank defined term identified in the comment remains unfixed.
